'''Anyara''' was a [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. In [[3957 BBY]], Anyara was part of a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and Republic [[Capture of Darth Revan|operation]] led by [[Bastila Shan]] to capture [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan]] aboard his [[Darth Revan's flagship|flagship]].<ref name="The Betrayal of Darth Revan">"[[The Betrayal of Darth Revan]]"</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Anyara was a pregenerated character made for the module.
